title: OpenAI Says New GPT-6 Cyber Model Hunts Flaws Without Crossing the Line
description: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Cyber, an advanced AI model designed for cybersecurity tasks, which significantly improves on its predecessor GPT-5.6 Cyber in vulnerability exploitation capabilities while maintaining strict adherence to authorized testing boundaries. The model demonstrated the ability to reproduce thousands of Linux kernel vulnerabilities and generate functional privilege escalation exploits, and it identified numerous high-severity flaws in Firefox, some of which are being patched by Mozilla. OpenAI has implemented safeguards to prevent misuse, including monitoring and restrictions to avoid unauthorized exploitation of critical systems. Access to GPT-6 Cyber is currently limited to approved customers for authorized security testing.
